what: The panel unfolds diagonally from above — the bottom-right corner drops to the screen bottom first, while the bottom-left corner starts half the panel height up (−50%) and follows down, covering with a tilted bottom edge (1.4s, cubic-bezier(.496,.004,0,1), slow at first then snapping shut at the end). On close, the bottom-right corner stretches to 150% then rolls up toward the top edge (1s expo.inOut)

options.on: load (unfolds once on attach, default) or open (the consumer sets data-open="true"/"false" opens and closes with)
options.dur: Opening duration (s), default 1.4 — 1 for page turns, 1.2 for menus
options.ease: Spread curve (four Bézier values), default 0.496,0.004,0,1 — the menu uses 0.16,1,0.3,1 (expo.out)

use: …
note: Fires fx:opening, fx:opened and fx:closed on open and close (bubbling). With reduced motion, goes straight to the fully opened or collapsed state

from.where: shared.js page unfold after first-visit loader (1.4s M0,0 C.496,.004 0,1 1,1) · barba transition (1s same curve) · menu open (1.2s expo.out) · close (1s expo.inOut, from 100% 150%) · footer orange veil
